name: Substituted amphetamines
summary: Substituted amphetamines is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Psychoactive substances of the substituted amphetamine class typically produce effects through dopaminergic, serotonergic, and adrenergic pathways. Psychedelic effects can be attributed to action on the 5-HT2A receptor. Stimulant and entactogenic effects are due to their action as releasing agents of dopamine, serotonin, epinephrine and norepinephrine or as agonists on the receptors of the previous neurotransmitters.

uses.text: By the 1930s, amphetamine and some of its derivative compounds found use as decongestants in the symptomatic treatment of colds and also occasionally as psychoactive agents.

sideEffects.en: Effects differ across the family. Stimulant members can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, poor sleep, anxiety, dependence and psychosis. Empathogens like MDMA can cause dangerous overheating and serotonin toxicity, and potent psychedelic members can cause severe anxiety, seizures and, in overdose, death.
sideEffects.zh: 這個家族成員的影響各不相同。興奮型成員可能造成心跳加速、血壓上升、體溫過高、失眠、焦慮、依賴與精神病。MDMA等同理心藥可能造成危險的體溫過高與血清素中毒，而強效的迷幻型成員可能造成嚴重焦慮、癲癇發作，過量時甚至死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这个家族成员的影响各不相同。兴奋型成员可能造成心跳加速、血压上升、体温过高、失眠、焦虑、依赖与精神病。MDMA等同理心药可能造成危险的体温过高与血清素中毒，而强效的迷幻型成员可能造成严重焦虑、癫痫发作，过量时甚至死亡。

fact.en: Amphetamine was first made in 1887 by the Romanian chemist Lazăr Edeleanu, but its stimulant effects were not recognised until the late 1920s.
fact.zh: 安非他命在1887年由羅馬尼亞化學家拉扎爾．埃德萊亞努首次合成，但它的興奮作用直到1920年代末才被發現。
fact.zhHans: 安非他命在1887年由罗马尼亚化学家拉扎尔．埃德莱亚努首次合成，但它的兴奋作用直到1920年代末才被发现。
